ledger_rows_before.name: _bitreadonly
ledger_rows_before.notes: Clean-room spec 001c5040; bitreadonly: VP6 raw bit reader non-consuming peek; static extern C reader keeps MSVC's private EAX reader / ESI count convention (reached through the PeekVp6RawBits wrapper absent from retail); no direct caller in retail; implemented from the spec plus retail only (no VP6 source read); full 47B exact; replaces the neutral name Rva001C5040PeekBits
